#### A gradient through a random draw

An encoder outputs $\mu$ and $\sigma$,
and the next layer gets a draw $z$ from $\dNf{\mu, \sigma^2}$.
How can we write $z$ so that the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) of the loss reaches $\mu$ and $\sigma$?

:::
